title: SaaS starter with login, pricing and dashboard
describe: a saas app with a login screen, a pricing page and a dashboard
prompt:
Build a small SaaS front end with three pages and no server.

Requirements:
- /pricing: a heading "Pricing" and plan cards Starter at $9 and Team at $29 per month. It is open to everyone.
- /login: a heading "Sign in", fields labelled "Email" and "Password", and a button "Sign in". Any non-empty email and password signs in and goes to /dashboard. The session is kept in the browser (local storage) so a reload stays signed in.
- /dashboard: a heading "Dashboard", three stat cards "Active users", "Revenue" and "Open tickets" with made-up numbers, and a button "Sign out". Signing out goes to /login.
- Opening /dashboard while signed out shows the /login page.
- Keep it all on the client; there is no server.
